name: svoj
description: SVOJ — a private planner/journal app. This package.json exists only to host the Capacitor iOS wrapper's tooling; the app itself is the single index.html file, which is copied verbatim into www/ as Capacitor's web asset directory.

scripts.build:web: mkdir -p www/assets && cp index.html manifest.webmanifest icon-*.png www/ && cp -R assets/. www/assets/
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync ios
